description: This Java class defines an exception called JsonTypeNotParsableException, which extends DittoRuntimeException. It is used to signal that a JSON string or object could not be parsed because of an unsupported or unknown JSON type. The class includes methods for constructing instances with specific messages or JSON content, as well as a builder class for flexible instantiation.

classes.name: JsonTypeNotParsableException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when JSON types are not parsable due to being unsupported or unknown. Extends DittoRuntimeException and provides static methods and a builder for creating instances with detailed context.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe inner static class that provides a fluent API to build instances of JsonTypeNotParsableException, allowing setting of message, description, cause, and href.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Builder instance initialized with the specified type and registry name.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a JsonTypeNotParsableException with a custom message and provided headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a JsonTypeNotParsableException from a JSON object and headers, extracting the message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified DittoHeaders, copying existing message, description, cause, and href.
